items.title: Filling an Oil Hanukkiah Together
items.alt: Two adults and a child gather around a glass oil hanukkiah as a man pours golden oil into one of its cups.
items.description: A small clear pitcher tilts above the row of glass wells while the child watches from behind the table. The adult and child wear blue kippot, and the unlit cotton wicks stand clear of the golden oil.

items.title: Sufganiyot and Gelt on a Dessert Table
items.alt: A blue-draped dessert table holds jelly doughnuts, foil chocolate coins and a freestanding six-pointed star decoration.
items.description: A richly patterned blue cloth falls over the crossed legs of the small wooden table. A plate of sugar-dusted doughnuts balances a bowl of blue-and-gold gelt below the standing star ornament.

items.title: Making a Paper Dreidel Puppet
items.alt: Black-and-white line art shows a boy in a kippah and glasses making a paper dreidel with a headscarf-wearing woman at a craft table.
items.description: The seated boy studies a small folded dreidel while the woman holds a larger paper model across the table. Scissors, glue and spare paper lie between them, with a candleholder at one end of the worktop.

items.title: Exchanging Hanukkah Treat Boxes
items.alt: Two adults exchange ribbon-tied boxes at a garden gate in black-and-white line art; the man wears a wide-brimmed hat and long coat.
items.description: The neighbors hold their decorated boxes between the gateposts and lanterns. A long dark coat, brimmed hat and neat sidelocks distinguish the man’s traditional dress beside the woman’s long buttoned coat.

items.title: Choosing Sufganiyot at the Bakery
items.alt: A child points toward jelly doughnuts in a bakery display while a baker stands behind the counter, in black-and-white line art.
items.description: Round filled doughnuts line the upper shelf above trays of cookies and spiral pastries. The child points through the display toward them as the apron-wearing baker stands beside a raised platter and candleholder.

items.title: Sorting Chocolate Gelt into Bowls
items.alt: Black-and-white line art shows two children sorting chocolate coins into small bowls at a round table with a dreidel and Hanukkah candles.
items.description: The boy in a patterned kippah and the girl in a floral skirt sort coins into separate shallow bowls. A small dreidel rests near the table’s edge beneath the outlined candleholder.
